plan.title: Submit bid on eRFX RFQ project

steps.note: Start an eRFX project create flow.
Configure the project as RFQ-only rather than the default Auction stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the vendor has an item to quote.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor corresponding to Vendor A.
Publish the RFQ project so the vendor can access it.
Confirm the project reached a real published event page.
Use the vendor portal to open the event, handle the vendor bid flow, quote 100, and submit.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the submitted bid.
Verify the buyer sees one direct vendor response on the RFQ stage.
Open the buyer's Master QCS for the submitted bid.
Verify Master QCS contains one real vendor column.
Verify the submitted quote of 100 appears in Master QCS.
